BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.

2. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.

3. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

7. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

9. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.

10. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.

11. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.

12. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.

13. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Doors.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.

14. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Windows.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.

15. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.

16. When learning Appropriate Technology in Building, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Appropriate Technology in Building.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Appropriate Technology in Building.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Water Supply and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Sanitary Appliances and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Drainage Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Building Construction Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
